verdict.overall: The biggest change since Sunday is a broad 6-12% rally in chip and AI-linked names (TSLA, AMD, AMAT, MU, AVGO), which pushed several nearest-week setups from neutral into opposing as resistance levels (ceilings) now sit just above price. NVDA is the standout, flipping to a supportive setup with trend intact, while AMD, PLTR, ZETA and APP look weakest given pricey options and earnings inside the next four weeks (PLTR Nov 2, AMD Nov 3, APP Nov 4, ZETA Nov 9, AMAT Nov 12). Overall confidence in clean range setups is softening, as fast price moves are outrunning where the options market had expected resistance.
